name: 20" forged Inferno wheel (Apex V8)
_note: A forged 20" wheel on uprated hubs and studs for the Apex: 2.5 kg lighter than the stock one, three times as tough, and it stays on. A wheel is torn off by a corner hit or kerb strike of 21 m/s or more (data/damage.json wheelOff); this one takes 2.5 times that (wheelHold), and with the Inferno suspension five times — a kerb's edge at 380 km/h no longer takes a wheel off.
